domain_restrictions: g is an integer satisfying g ≥ 2 (so g−1 and g−2 are defined and are ≥ 0)
N(k) is defined for integers k = g, g−1, g−2 (implicitly meaning genus is allowed to be any integer ≥ 0)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers g ≥ 2, the number of numerical semigroups of genus g is at least the sum of the numbers of numerical semigroups of genus g−1 and genus g−2: N(g) ≥ N(g−1) + N(g−2).
quantifier_order: for every g ∈ Z with g ≥ 2

variables.name: g
variables.role: genus parameter indexing counts of numerical semigroups

witness_dependencies: none explicitly (the inequality compares cardinalities/counts only)

statement_nl: Let N(g) denote the number of numerical semigroups of genus g. Prove that N(g) ≥ N(g−1) + N(g−2) for every integer g ≥ 2.
